SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, c.description AS description, c.school AS school, c.teacher_id AS teacherId, CASE WHEN u.nickname IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(u.nickname) != '' THEN u.nickname ELSE u.username END AS teacherName, c.create_time AS createTime FROM `class` c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.teacher_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
AND ( c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.school LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
OR c.id = #{classId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `user` teacher_search WHERE teacher_search.id = c.teacher_id AND teacher_search.is_deleted = 0 AND ( teacher_search.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR teacher_search.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) )
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_student cs_empty WHERE cs_empty.class_id = c.id)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_student cs_member WHERE cs_member.class_id = c.id)
ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC ORDER BY c.name ASC, c.id ASC ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
